cues.en: Hi, and welcome to another AI in C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看另一支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to do a deep dive into chat reducers because we have made a previous video before, links in the description,
cues.zh: 今天要深入介紹對話縮減器，之前我們曾經拍過一支影片，連結放在說明中，

cues.en: about the two built-in chat reducers.
cues.zh: 介紹兩個內建的對話縮減器。

cues.en: But what if we want to do something different than just reduce the number of messages or do a simple summary?
cues.zh: 但如果我們想做的，不只是限制訊息數量或產生簡單摘要呢？

cues.en: We are able to make our own custom reducers, and that's what we're going to cover today.
cues.zh: 我們可以自行建立自訂縮減器，這就是今天的主題。

cues.en: So we have the previous sample here, chat history reducer, and the link to the video about that,
cues.zh: 這裡是先前的 Chat History Reducer 範例，以及相關影片的連結，

cues.en: where we went in and used the message counting reducer and the summary reducer, meaning four messages, get down to four messages again,
cues.zh: 當時我們使用訊息計數縮減器與摘要縮減器，例如將訊息減少到四則，

cues.en: and summary after four messages, summarized.
cues.zh: 或在四則訊息後進行摘要。

cues.en: But now we're going to go in and see not the built-in ones, but the built-in ones, as you can see here, is just an iChatReducer interface.
cues.zh: 今天不只使用內建功能。如你所見，內建縮減器其實就是實作 IChatReducer 介面。

cues.en: So we can make our own, and then the first one I'm going to make here,
cues.zh: 因此我們可以自行建立，這裡先介紹第一個範例，

cues.en: or let's run it first so we can actually see how it works without any chat reducers.
cues.zh: 或者先執行一次，看看完全沒有對話縮減器時會如何。

cues.en: That might help a little with the understanding of this.
cues.zh: 這應該比較容易幫助你理解。

cues.en: So if I say hello to it,
cues.zh: 如果我先說聲你好，

cues.en: this sample will just write out the answer, how many number of messages there were, and who wrote them, user or assistant.
cues.zh: 這個範例會輸出回覆、訊息總數，以及每則訊息是使用者還是助理寫的。

cues.en: And I also put in a tool so we can see tools in this.
cues.zh: 另外我也加入一個工具，方便觀察工具訊息。

cues.en: What is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 「巴黎現在的天氣如何？」

cues.en: And because we have a session on, we can of course see that both say hello, hello back, what is the weather like in Paris, then we get the tool call for get weather,
cues.zh: 由於有使用 session，可以看到前面的問候、回覆，以及巴黎天氣的問題，接著是 GetWeather 的工具呼叫，

cues.en: and the tool result back, and then the final result.
cues.zh: 再來是工具結果，最後則是正式回覆。

cues.en: And if we keep doing this,
cues.zh: 如果繼續進行對話，

cues.en: we will see that this just builds up.
cues.zh: 訊息就會不斷累積。

cues.en: And this is of course good for the AI, because now we could go in and say,
cues.zh: 這對 AI 當然有幫助，因為我們可以接著問：

cues.en: what cities have we talked about?
cues.zh: 「我們討論過哪些城市？」

cues.en: And it would come back and say, we have two cities, Paris and Copenhagen.
cues.zh: 它就會回答，討論過兩個城市：巴黎與哥本哈根。

cues.en: And it can only do that because it has the entire history.
cues.zh: 它能這樣回答，是因為掌握完整的對話歷程。

cues.en: But there could be reasons for getting rid of this history, mostly tokens and latency, because the more we send, the more there will be here.
cues.zh: 不過也有理由需要刪減歷程，主要是 Token 用量與延遲；傳送的內容越多，負擔就越大。

cues.en: So the first one I want to introduce you to is one I made all back in Semantic Kernel, but I have now built here as well in Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 第一個要介紹的縮減器，是我以前在 Semantic Kernel 就寫過，現在也移植到 Agent Framework 的版本。

cues.en: And that is one that always just removes all tool calls.
cues.zh: 它會一律移除所有工具呼叫。

cues.en: So the way you do an iChat reducer is you just inherit from it or implement it, given that it's an interface.
cues.zh: 建立 IChatReducer 的方式，就是繼承它，或更精確地說，因為它是介面，所以要實作它。

cues.en: And the only thing you need to implement is a reduce async that takes in the previous messages and a cancellation token, and spits back what messages should be kept.
cues.zh: 唯一需要實作的是 ReduceAsync：接收先前訊息與取消權杖，回傳要保留的訊息。

cues.en: So any messages we take out of this and put back in will be used and the rest will be gone.
cues.zh: 你放進回傳結果的訊息會被保留，其他訊息則會被移除。

cues.en: I'll put in a little utility just to see that it's been called.
cues.zh: 我先加一點輔助輸出，確認這個方法有被呼叫。

cues.en: And then what are we doing here?
cues.zh: 那這裡做了什麼呢？

cues.en: We are making a list of the messages we want to keep from the previous messages.
cues.zh: 我們建立一個清單，放入要從既有訊息中保留的項目。

cues.en: We are going in and say if that message is of role tool, then we get rid of it, meaning we just skip it, don't put it in to keep.
cues.zh: 如果訊息的角色是 tool，就直接略過，不放進保留清單。

cues.en: Or if the message is from the assistant and it has a tool call request, meaning a function call content, then we also get rid of it.
cues.zh: 或者，如果訊息來自助理，且包含工具呼叫請求，也就是 FunctionCallContent，同樣移除。

cues.en: So let's see that as an action, in that we set a breakpoint here, and we go up and say that instead of no reducers,
cues.zh: 現在在這裡設中斷點，然後回到上方，把原本不使用縮減器的設定，

cues.en: we want to use the always remove tool calls reducer.
cues.zh: 改為使用一律移除工具呼叫的縮減器。

cues.en: So let's run.
cues.zh: 開始執行。

cues.en: Put this side by side so we can see.
cues.zh: 把視窗並排，方便查看。

cues.en: So if I just say hello,
cues.zh: 先說聲你好，

cues.en: we can see it's called a reducer, and in the first case, because this is the first message, our previous message is actually zero.
cues.zh: 可以看到縮減器被呼叫了。由於這是第一則訊息，先前訊息數量是零。

cues.en: So technically it makes no sense to go to this because we just get to keep zero out of zero.
cues.zh: 因此這次其實沒什麼可做，只是從零則訊息中保留零則。

cues.en: And it will come back. Hello, how can I assist you today?
cues.zh: 接著它回覆：「你好，今天有什麼可以協助你的？」

cues.en: So if I say, how are you?
cues.zh: 然後我問：「你好嗎？」

cues.en: Again, we are called here.
cues.zh: 這裡又被呼叫一次。

cues.en: We get now two messages, so we don't get the third one, how are you, but we only get the two prior to what we're just about to call.
cues.zh: 現在取得兩則訊息，不包含第三則「你好嗎？」，只包含本次呼叫之前的兩則。

cues.en: And again, this happens before we get a message.
cues.zh: 也就是說，這個處理發生在取得新回覆之前。

cues.en: So the two ones we have here is hello and hello back.
cues.zh: 目前的兩則訊息，就是你好，以及對方的問候回覆。

cues.en: So we call again the tool, and what to keep?
cues.zh: 接著逐一判斷要保留哪些訊息。

cues.en: Well, the first message is just hello, so it shouldn't be removed, and the second message is also just a response back.
cues.zh: 第一則只是你好，不應移除；第二則也只是一般回覆。

cues.en: But it's your logic in C-sharp, so you can do pretty much anything here.
cues.zh: 不過篩選邏輯完全由你的 C# 程式決定，所以幾乎什麼都能做。

cues.en: You'll see a few other examples.
cues.zh: 後面還會看到其他範例。

cues.en: So it came back, I'm just a programmer.
cues.zh: 它回覆說，自己只是一個程式。

cues.en: So now we can, for example, say, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 現在可以問：「巴黎的天氣如何？」

cues.en: And for context here, I just gave the agent a tool,
cues.zh: 補充一下，我只給代理程式一個工具，

cues.en: get weather, which just say it's sunny and 90 degrees, no matter what city it is, just for testing.
cues.zh: 就是 GetWeather；為了測試，不論哪個城市，都固定回覆晴天、19 度。

cues.en: So if we call this, again, we hit the reducer, we have four messages now, the hello and how are you, and we're still not going to remove anything,
cues.zh: 呼叫時再次進入縮減器；目前有你好與你好嗎的四則訊息，仍然不會移除任何內容，

cues.en: because the tool calls have not happened yet.
cues.zh: 因為工具呼叫還沒發生。

cues.en: So it always happens prior to the call, not after the call, because that could essentially remove some of the new stuff.
cues.zh: 縮減一律在呼叫之前執行，而不是呼叫之後，否則可能會把剛產生的新內容移除。

cues.en: So we're going to them, we see that we keep all four, because none of them are tool-related.
cues.zh: 因此這裡保留全部四則，因為都與工具無關。

cues.en: And it comes back, and we can now see we have eight messages in here.
cues.zh: 回覆後，現在可以看到總共有八則訊息。

cues.en: So we saw the four before, and then we said, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 除了原本四則，又多了巴黎天氣的問題，

cues.en: We got a tool call for get weather, and we got a tool result back for what it was, and then the assistant came back and summarized these two things.
cues.zh: GetWeather 工具呼叫、工具回傳結果，以及助理根據工具結果整理的回覆。

cues.en: So now we can try and say, what about Copenhagen?
cues.zh: 現在試著問：「那哥本哈根呢？」

cues.en: Meaning the weather in Copenhagen.
cues.zh: 也就是詢問哥本哈根的天氣。

cues.en: So now we get our eight messages, but now we can see that at some points, let me just set some breakpoints here,
cues.zh: 這次取得八則訊息；先讓我在幾個位置設中斷點，

cues.en: we get a message that was the tool call, meaning it was this one here.
cues.zh: 這裡就會碰到工具呼叫訊息，也就是畫面上的這一則。

cues.en: So where it asks, I need to call the get weather tool, and we're now just skipping that, and we also get the tool back, meaning this one here,
cues.zh: 它表示要呼叫 GetWeather 工具，我們會略過這則；接著也會遇到工具結果，就是這一則，

cues.en: and we're also skipping that.
cues.zh: 同樣把它略過。

cues.en: So if we set a breakpoint up here, we now have six messages we want to return, and that is the hello, so the back and forward that we have really seen,
cues.zh: 如果在這裡設中斷點，現在只會回傳六則，也就是實際看見的那些往返文字，

cues.en: but the tool call is now gone.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫已經消失了。

cues.en: And we need to remove both the assistant request and the tool, else the AI will actually break down and say,
cues.zh: 助理的工具請求與工具結果必須一起移除，否則 AI 會報錯，表示，

cues.en: there isn't a matching pair of request and result of this tool.
cues.zh: 工具請求與結果沒有成對對應。

cues.en: But if we do this, and you can just copy this if you want to have this, we now see that that is what is being sent prior,
cues.zh: 這份程式碼可以直接複製使用。現在可以看到，下一次呼叫前送出的內容，

cues.en: and we get rid of the tool calls up here for the ask of Paris, but we of course see the new tool call down here
cues.zh: 已經移除了詢問巴黎時的工具呼叫，但下方當然仍會出現新的工具呼叫，

cues.en: for the new message.
cues.zh: 因為這是這次新訊息產生的。

cues.en: But when we send the next one, it will remove those two as well.
cues.zh: 下一次再送出訊息時，這兩則也會被移除。

cues.en: So this one will always remove all tools, but the tools that were used in the last sent message. Okay.
cues.zh: 因此這個縮減器會移除先前的所有工具訊息，只留下最新一輪所產生的工具訊息。

cues.en: Let's try something else.
cues.zh: 我們再試另一種做法。

cues.en: Let's try to just make a thing that gets rid of the word sunny in messages,
cues.zh: 例如，建立一個縮減器，移除訊息中出現 sunny 這個字的內容，

cues.en: because they don't need to be as big as all this up here.
cues.zh: 因為縮減器不一定要像剛才那樣寫那麼多程式碼。

cues.en: Here, it can simply see to remove all previous messages that contains the word sunny in the invariant case.
cues.zh: 這裡只需要用不區分大小寫的方式，移除所有包含 sunny 的先前訊息。

cues.en: So if we do that, let me get rid of this one, so we can see.
cues.zh: 我們來試試，先把這個中斷點移除，方便查看。

cues.en: Essentially, we're just taking the previous messages and filtering them a bit.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是對先前訊息做一點篩選。

cues.en: That could be filtering for some words that shouldn't be there or out-of-date information or whatever it is.
cues.zh: 你可以過濾不應出現的文字、過時資訊，或其他任何內容。

cues.en: But if we take these messages with word reducer and set it to be the chat reducer, and restart.
cues.zh: 把這個以文字篩選訊息的縮減器設為對話縮減器，然後重新啟動。

cues.en: So now we can again say, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 現在再次詢問：「巴黎的天氣如何？」

cues.en: And we will get our four messages, the user message, the tool call request, the tool back, and the assistant.
cues.zh: 我們會得到四則訊息：使用者問題、工具呼叫請求、工具結果與助理回覆。

cues.en: And we can see that it mentioned the word sunny.
cues.zh: 而且可以看到裡面出現了 sunny。

cues.en: So if we say, how about Copenhagen?
cues.zh: 接著問：「那哥本哈根呢？」

cues.en: It might surprise you what you will see back.
cues.zh: 回傳的結果可能會讓你有點意外。

cues.en: We will see that we have seven messages.
cues.zh: 這次會看到七則訊息。

cues.en: We have the user.
cues.zh: 這裡有使用者訊息，

cues.en: We have the assistant.
cues.zh: 還有助理訊息，

cues.en: We have the sunny and 19 degrees.
cues.zh: 也還看得到晴天與 19 度。

cues.en: But we said we wanted to get rid of those.
cues.zh: 但我們不是說要把它們移除嗎？

cues.en: Well, down here, I only... Let me find it.
cues.zh: 其實下方我只設定……讓我找一下，

cues.en: I only set the one that had text in them.
cues.zh: 只針對有 Text 的訊息處理。

cues.en: And this is not text, this is content.
cues.zh: 而這個不是文字，它是 Content。

cues.en: So if you want to get rid of everything that has anything to do with tools, you first need to check each tool if they mention the word sunny.
cues.zh: 所以如果要移除所有與工具相關、含有 sunny 的內容，就必須另外檢查每一筆工具內容。

cues.en: So the only thing that is gone here is actually the first reply back.
cues.zh: 因此這裡真正消失的，只有第一次的正式回覆。

cues.en: The weather in Paris is sunny and 19 degrees. That is gone.
cues.zh: 也就是「巴黎天氣晴朗，氣溫 19 度」那一則。

cues.en: And now we only have the Copenhagen weather.
cues.zh: 現在只剩哥本哈根的天氣回覆。

cues.en: So it's a bit contrived, but just to show you that whenever you do this, it is your job to get rid of whatever it is.
cues.zh: 這個例子有點刻意，主要是提醒你，使用縮減器時，要移除什麼都必須自己處理。

cues.en: And in this case, text is only the one that actually gets rid of the final assistant message.
cues.zh: 在這裡，檢查 Text 只會移除最後的助理文字回覆。

cues.en: Let's try another one.
cues.zh: 我們再試一個。

cues.en: We can also go in and use agents within the chat reducer.
cues.zh: 也可以在對話縮減器裡使用代理程式。

cues.en: So in this case, I'm making a pirate summary reducer agent.
cues.zh: 這裡我建立一個海盜風格的摘要縮減代理程式。

cues.en: So it's a little like the summary chat reducer up here, but we get more control. We can use tools and so on.
cues.zh: 它有點像上方的摘要縮減器，但能更自由地控制，例如加入工具。

cues.en: We can technically do that up here, but it's not with the agent framework, it's with the underlying Microsoft Extensions AI.
cues.zh: 上方其實也做得到，只是使用的是底層 Microsoft.Extensions.AI，而不是 Agent Framework。

cues.en: So in this case, I'm just making a pirate summary reducer and telling it, giving the input messages, make a summary of them in the voice of a pirate.
cues.zh: 這裡建立海盜摘要縮減器，指示它把輸入訊息，以海盜的口吻整理成摘要。

cues.en: And I'm saying it only needs to happen after four messages.
cues.zh: 而且要累積超過四則訊息後才執行。

cues.en: So let's take this one, and then we'll see the code in one second.
cues.zh: 先選用這個版本，稍後再看程式碼。

cues.en: So we'll just go down here and set up.
cues.zh: 到這裡設定一下。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: So we will try again to say, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 再問一次：「巴黎的天氣如何？」

cues.en: We see that our tool is being called, but we will just say no summary yet because we only have zero messages
cues.zh: 可以看到縮減器被呼叫了，但目前還不做摘要，因為先前訊息數是零，

cues.en: and not the minimum four before we actually do a summarization.
cues.zh: 還沒達到開始摘要所需的四則。

cues.en: We can try again and say, what about Copenhagen?
cues.zh: 再問：「那哥本哈根呢？」

cues.en: We only have four messages, and in this case we have set four or lower, so still no summarization.
cues.zh: 目前只有四則，這裡的設定是四則以下不處理，因此仍不做摘要。

cues.en: So we now have eight messages with the message from Paris and a message from Copenhagen.
cues.zh: 現在加上巴黎與哥本哈根這兩輪對話，共有八則訊息。

cues.en: Let's say Berlin.
cues.zh: 接著問柏林。

cues.en: We now have eight messages, so we have one to do summary.
cues.zh: 現在已有八則，因此需要執行摘要。

cues.en: And we put in an agent, so we can just use that agent for any kind of thing we want.
cues.zh: 由於放進來的是代理程式，所以可以用它做任何需要的處理。

cues.en: In this case, we gave it instructions to agent that given the input amount, summarizing the voice of a pirate.
cues.zh: 這個範例給它的指示，是把輸入的訊息，

cues.en: That given the input amount, summarizing the voice of a pirate.
cues.zh: 用海盜的口吻整理成摘要。

cues.en: This is just an agent framework call like any other.
cues.zh: 這與其他 Agent Framework 呼叫沒有差別。

cues.en: So it will come back and, in this case, summarize those eight messages.
cues.zh: 它會回傳結果，這次就是把八則訊息整理成摘要。

cues.en: Now we're only returning one message back.
cues.zh: 現在只回傳一則訊息。

cues.en: So we have essentially taken the eight messages, turned it into one message.
cues.zh: 也就是把八則訊息轉成一則。

cues.en: So we will see that we have five messages.
cues.zh: 因此畫面上總共會看到五則訊息。

cues.en: So we have the summarized message, we have the Berlin message, we have the AI requesting the tool,
cues.zh: 其中有一則摘要、一則詢問柏林的訊息、一則 AI 工具呼叫請求，

cues.en: and the tool response, and back what actually happens.
cues.zh: 工具的回覆，以及最後的正式答案。

cues.en: So that makes all sense.
cues.zh: 這樣就很合理。

cues.en: We normally get four messages every time we ask.
cues.zh: 通常每問一次，都會新增四則訊息。

cues.en: One input, one output, and the two tool calling request and response.
cues.zh: 一則輸入、一則輸出，以及工具呼叫的請求與回覆。

cues.en: The fifth one is now our summary.
cues.zh: 第五則就是剛產生的摘要。

cues.en: And given that we have a summary now, we can go in and say,
cues.zh: 既然現在有摘要，就可以問：

cues.en: what cities have we talked about so far?
cues.zh: 「到目前為止，我們討論過哪些城市？」

cues.en: Again, we get five messages, which is more than what we want, so we actually do a summarization of this prior.
cues.zh: 現在有五則訊息，超過設定的數量，所以呼叫前會再做一次摘要。

cues.en: So it will talk about all the cities and so on.
cues.zh: 摘要裡會提到所有城市等資訊。

cues.en: We will send that.
cues.zh: 接著把它送出去。

cues.en: And it will come and say, the cities mentioned so far are Paris, Copenhagen, and Berlin.
cues.zh: 它就會回答：目前提過巴黎、哥本哈根與柏林。

cues.en: And now we're down to three messages because we only got the summary, the question, and the answer,
cues.zh: 現在只剩三則訊息，分別是摘要、問題與答案，

cues.en: because it didn't need to do any calls to the tools.
cues.zh: 因為這次不需要呼叫任何工具。

cues.en: Had we asked, the city mentioned so far, what are their weather?
cues.zh: 如果改問：「剛才提到的城市，現在天氣分別如何？」

cues.en: We can try and do it.
cues.zh: 我們可以試看看。

cues.en: Now we again do a summary.
cues.zh: 這次同樣會先檢查是否需要摘要。

cues.en: Now we're down to three, so we don't do a summary, of course, because we are below the four.
cues.zh: 目前只有三則，低於四則，所以當然不做摘要。

cues.en: And now we see a bunch of extra tool calls because it grabbed three tool calls, one for Paris, one for Copenhagen, one for Berlin.
cues.zh: 現在會出現一批額外的工具呼叫，因為它分別針對巴黎、哥本哈根與柏林呼叫了三次工具。

cues.en: And the prior got the same message back for all of them because it's just hard-coded.
cues.zh: 代理程式取得的都是相同結果，因為工具回覆是寫死的。

cues.en: But that makes sense that we can get multiple backs, and now we get the summary again, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 這也說明一次可能取得多筆工具結果，之後還會繼續進行摘要。

cues.en: Of course, summary will cost extra because we do both in cost and time if we do an agent, but you could do pretty much anything here.
cues.zh: 使用代理程式做摘要，當然會多花費用與時間，不過這裡幾乎可以實作任何處理。

cues.en: And I've tried to do one more of these where I do a city reducer agent.
cues.zh: 我也另外做了一個例子：城市縮減代理程式。

cues.en: So given the input number messages, return the numbers of the messages that contains a city name.
cues.zh: 它會接收編號後的訊息，回傳哪些訊息包含城市名稱。

cues.en: So this one, let's put it down here and have a look at it.
cues.zh: 把這個版本放到這裡，來看看。

cues.en: This is a bit more contrived, but just for you to see.
cues.zh: 這個例子比較刻意，主要是讓你了解可能的做法。

cues.en: So if we have no messages, we don't need to do anything, but if we do have any messages, we can go in and first use one of the other reducers,
cues.zh: 如果沒有訊息，就不需要處理；如果有訊息，可以先使用另一個縮減器，

cues.en: meaning I just get rid of all the tool calls on the fly by doing reduce down here.
cues.zh: 也就是在這裡先呼叫 Reduce，把所有工具呼叫移除。

cues.en: This is the best way of chaining it because you can't chain them up in Agent Framework yourself, but you can easily just new up one of the other reducers
cues.zh: 這是串接縮減器的好方法，因為 Agent Framework 不能直接設定多個縮減器，但可以自行建立另一個縮減器，

cues.en: and quickly call reduce before you work with the data.
cues.zh: 在處理資料之前先呼叫它的 Reduce。

cues.en: And then I'm building up a message of all the messages in string and send them into the system,
cues.zh: 然後把所有訊息組合成字串，再送進模型，

cues.en: so it can give me back what numbered lines are to be containing a city and then get rid of it.
cues.zh: 讓它回傳哪些編號行包含城市，接著將那些訊息移除。

cues.en: So the best way to understand that one is probably to set a breakpoint here and restart.
cues.zh: 要理解這個例子，最好的方式可能是在這裡設中斷點，再重新執行。

cues.en: So if we say, what is the weather like in Paris, we of course are called, that's zero, so we don't need to do anything,
cues.zh: 先問「巴黎的天氣如何？」；這時會呼叫縮減器，但訊息數是零，所以不需要處理，

cues.en: and push it back.
cues.zh: 直接回傳。

cues.en: How about Copenhagen?
cues.zh: 再問：「那哥本哈根呢？」

cues.en: So now we see that we have a user message, of course, that is Paris.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到使用者訊息，內容當然提到了巴黎。

cues.en: We have a couple of tool calls, and we have the word Paris here again.
cues.zh: 還有工具呼叫，以及這裡再次出現的巴黎。

cues.en: So if we do this, try and quickly stop the video and think what would you expect comes back.
cues.zh: 先暫停影片，想一想，你預期最後會回傳什麼？

cues.en: Okay, let's try and do it.
cues.zh: 好，我們來試試。

cues.en: So we have four previous messages, so we say we will always get rid of tool calls,
cues.zh: 目前有四則先前訊息，我們設定一律移除工具呼叫，

cues.en: meaning we call that one.
cues.zh: 因此先呼叫那個縮減器。

cues.en: Let me quickly get out of it, so we go down here.
cues.zh: 我先快速跳出，回到下方。

cues.en: So now we have just taken the four messages and reduced them to two.
cues.zh: 現在四則訊息已經縮減成兩則，

cues.en: And that is the original one and the real answer.
cues.zh: 分別是原本的問題與實際回覆。

cues.en: So the tool calls are gone.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫都移除了。

cues.en: And now we build a small string builder here.
cues.zh: 接著建立一個小型 StringBuilder。

cues.en: So what we are saying is, zero is this line, one is this line.
cues.zh: 也就是把這行編成 0、這行編成 1。

cues.en: Then I'm doing structured output to tell, give me all the lines that actually have a city named.
cues.zh: 然後透過結構化輸出，要求它列出所有包含城市名稱的行號。

cues.en: In this case, it's both the line index zero and index one.
cues.zh: 這裡就是索引 0 與索引 1。

cues.en: So given that both of these contain the word Paris, we actually remove all messages.
cues.zh: 因為這兩則訊息都包含巴黎，所以全部訊息都被移除。

cues.en: And that results in, if we have a look, the weather in Copenhagen is currently sunny with the temperature of 90 degrees.
cues.zh: 看看結果，回覆是「哥本哈根目前晴朗，氣溫 19 度」。

cues.en: So the reason why it knows this is because it, what about Copenhagen?
cues.zh: 它能回答，是因為我們問了「那哥本哈根呢？」

cues.en: And it had a getWeather, but it had no context of weather.
cues.zh: 而它知道有 GetWeather 工具，但其實已經沒有先前天氣對話的上下文。

cues.en: So this is just the AI being clever enough that what about Copenhagen is getWeather.
cues.zh: 這只是 AI 夠聰明，自己把「那哥本哈根呢？」解讀成要呼叫 GetWeather。

cues.en: But had we said hello prior to this, and then ask for this, let's try to do it.
cues.zh: 但如果在這之前先打招呼，再問這些問題，我們來試看看。

cues.en: Let me get rid of all these breakpoints so we can just see it.
cues.zh: 先把全部中斷點移除，直接觀察結果。

cues.en: So let's say first hi to it.
cues.zh: 首先對它說聲你好。

cues.en: That comes back.
cues.zh: 它回覆了。

cues.en: What's the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 「巴黎的天氣如何？」

cues.en: That comes back, which is okay.
cues.zh: 它也回覆了，沒有問題。

cues.en: And what about Copenhagen?
cues.zh: 「那哥本哈根呢？」

cues.en: Now we can see that the hi is there, the how back, and then we get to what about Copenhagen.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到前面的你好與回覆都還在，接著是「那哥本哈根呢？」。

cues.en: And now you can see it's a bit unsure.
cues.zh: 這時它就有點不確定了。

cues.en: Are you talking about the weather or is it something else?
cues.zh: 「你是在問天氣，還是其他事情？」

cues.en: Because the context was lost because all the messages that had a city name involved was removed.
cues.zh: 因為所有提及城市名稱的訊息都已被移除，所以上下文不見了。

cues.en: Again, a bit contrived, but again, the primary message here is you have full control to do anything you want in here.
cues.zh: 這個例子雖然有點刻意，但重點是：這裡的處理方式完全由你控制。

cues.en: You just get, here are some messages, which of them do I want to keep?
cues.zh: 你拿到一批訊息，再決定要保留哪些。

cues.en: You can use AI, you can use regex, you can use common sense, you can use counting, anything you can do to your imagination,
cues.zh: 你可以用 AI、正規表示式、一般邏輯、計數，或任何想得到的方式，

cues.en: you can do here in order to get rid of that.
cues.zh: 來決定如何縮減訊息。

cues.en: So that's everything. See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容，我們下支影片見。
